deployments_detail.use: Generative AI to make shopping more inspiring/entertaining; AI cited as growth driver and efficiency lever in Q1 2026 results
deployments_detail.value: AI credited for record revenue & efficiency (self-claimed, Q1 2026)

deployments_detail.use: Zalando Assistant: conversational AI fashion advisor that gives styling/outfit recommendations from natural-language queries, understanding context like location, weather and occasion. Powered by Zalando's own models plus OpenAI GPT-4o mini (upgraded from GPT-3.5). Live for logged-in customers across all 25 markets in local languages. [OpenAI (GPT-4o mini)]
deployments_detail.value: 12x traffic scaled across 25 markets without significant cost increase; 23% increase in product clicks in recommendation carousels; 41% rise in wishlist adds; 5% reduction in unhelpful recommendations

deployments_detail.use: Markdown/discount price steering: forecast-then-optimize ML pipeline predicting demand, return rates, fulfillment costs and residual values to optimize discounts for 1M+ products weekly. Uses statistical, tree-based and Transformer-based deep learning models. Run in production by Zalando's forecasting team on Amazon SageMaker. [AWS (Amazon SageMaker)]
deployments_detail.value: ~10 billion forecast records processed weekly; weekly savings of 3-4 hours per ML model in operations/maintenance; serves ~50M active customers

deployments_detail.use: Search quality assurance using LLM-as-a-judge (multimodal): evaluates semantic relevance of catalog search results at scale before new-market launches and for existing-market validation, scoring relevance 0-4. Uses GPT-4o. Production QA framework. [OpenAI (GPT-4o)]
deployments_detail.value: ~$250 per full evaluation run; 3-5 hours per cycle; tests 1,500 search segments per market with 25 results each; high correlation with human judgement

deployments_detail.use: High-fidelity 3D digital product twins of footwear via the ALLSIDES NVIDIA-powered platform, integrated into Zalando's ShopAR for interactive 3D views, AR try-on and marketing content. Deployed across the e-commerce platform. [NVIDIA / ALLSIDES]
deployments_detail.value: 10,000 footwear SKUs in 3D by Dec 2025 (targeting 45,000 by 2026); 7-minute automated scans; 15-20% increase in time on product pages; 3-4% add-to-cart uplift; up to 92.1% reduction in cost per 3D scan

deployments_detail.use: Size & fit recommendations using machine learning and computer vision: analyzes brand measurements, return history and product images to give size flags, plus body-measurement prediction from two smartphone photos (front/side) for personalized size recommendations. Live in the e-commerce platform. [none]
deployments_detail.value: Reduces size-related returns by 10% where size advice is provided; one third of Zalando's overall returns are size-related

deployments_detail.use: Generative AI content production for marketing/editorial imagery, plus 'digital twins' (high-fidelity 3D replicas of real models built with ORENDT STUDIOS). AI-generated content is deployed; digital twins in pilot. Used to produce campaign imagery and product videos at scale. [ORENDT STUDIOS (digital twins partner)]
deployments_detail.value: ~70% of editorial campaign assets AI-generated in Q4 2024; tailored content produced in under 24 hours; per Reuters, imagery production cut from 6-8 weeks to 3-4 days and costs reduced ~90%

deployments_detail.use: Advertising partnership as a launch partner in OpenAI's ChatGPT advertising pilot, placing Zalando fashion/lifestyle assortment inside ChatGPT conversations, leveraging the Zalando Assistant. Described as early-stage pilot launching in the UK. [OpenAI (ChatGPT)]

Dynamic inventory optimisation and probabilistic demand forecasting for the ZEOS marketplace/logistics platform: LightGBM + Nixtla MLForecast demand forecasting across 5M SKUs, Monte Carlo simulation and gradient-free optimisers for replenishment/inventory allocation. Daily batch + real-time interactive partner guidance. In production on AWS SageMaker, Databricks and internal zFlow. [AWS SageMaker, Databricks, Nixtla MLForecast, LightGBM]
deployments_detail.value: Demand forecast pipeline processes 3 years of data for 5M SKUs in under 2 hours; feature store 10-20ms per SKU; related paper reports up to 22.1% GMV uplift from replenishment optimisation

deployments_detail.use: AI-driven warehouse picking robots (Nomagic Shoebox Picker) using AI perception and robot control with intelligent grippers to handle two-piece/unsealed shoeboxes traditionally hard to automate. Deployed in Zalando's Verona, Italy warehouse. [Nomagic]

Product attribute/metadata extraction from unstructured product images using generative AI, developed with the AWS Generative AI Innovation Center on Amazon Bedrock. [AWS (Amazon Bedrock, GenAI Innovation Center)]
